GTA 6 Garages & Properties

Free garages, every purchasable garage with its reported price, safehouses and storage rules.

18 sourced guides. Positions are deliberately unpinned until coordinate evidence is reliable — each guide gives the area and the source's own directions.

Port Gellhorn Station GarageYour first extra garage costs nothing — a friendly mechanic sees to that. Paradise GarageA free garage out past the Grassrivers — but only some editions of the game include it. Mitchell Auto CenterThe cheapest garage in Leonida, an easy drive from where Chapter 2 plays out. Persistence Road GarageA budget garage on the road north out of Vice City. 7th Avenue GarageHandy storage just off the airport highway in south Vice City. Store 'N' BoltStorage up by the big monument at the north end of Ambrosia. Wyatt MotorsA mid-priced garage right next to a spray shop in the middle of Ambrosia. Vela Rota Drive GaragePricey storage in the middle of Capri's rich streets — where the good cars live. Bonita Court GarageIsland storage in the middle of Washington Island. Atlantic Court GarageThe most expensive garage in Leonida, a short walk from the Ocean Beach strip. Party House Keypad GarageA party house in the Keys hides a garage behind a six-digit keypad — the car inside is the prize. Story Safehouses (Jason & Lucia)You can't buy a house in Leonida — the story moves you into a new home each chapter instead. Vehicle Storage Rules: Parking Is Not RegisteringLeaving a stolen car in your garage keeps it for now — but it isn't yours until the paperwork is done. Thompson Court GarageA free two-car garage arrives with a Chapter 4 story job. NE 15th Street GarageA free Stockyard garage lands late in the story. Pegassi Residences GarageThe biggest story garage sits under a luxury tower — and shares its basement with a certain Ultimate Edition car. Shore Court GarageA bonus Ocean Beach garage that arrives with a classic car already in it. GTA+ Crosstown GarageA membership garage in Crosstown, with a '90s coupe thrown in.

Leonida Fieldnotes is an independent, unofficial fan companion for Grand Theft Auto VI. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Every guide is sourced from a published report and labelled with its confidence tier; nothing here is presented as personally verified in-game, and no position is pinned without reliable coordinate evidence.
